title: Midpoint relation and bounded step chains
statement: Let $w,r\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $E$ be a relation on finite bit strings. For all bit strings $A,B$ of length $w$, the midpoint relation of depth $r$ holds between $A$ and $B$ if and only if there is a chain of $2^r$ transitions from $A$ to $B$ in which every intermediate string has length $w$ and each transition satisfies $E$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is a relation on finite bit strings
